spellbook.finance/limitations: This writes account-level shipping policies that can affect eligible eBay listings across all of the caller's workspaces; workspaceId validates owner access only. It requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization.
Provider policy readback does not prove listing association or buyer checkout totals; consult returned missingFields and limitations.

description: Set a package flat shipping charge and optionally an envelope charge on the caller's connected eBay account, then return provider readback. Read spellbook_ebay_shipping_policy_get first; omitting the envelope amount preserves its current charge. workspaceId is checked for owner access; the connected account belongs to the caller.

envelopeFlatRateUsd.description: Optional seller-selected flat envelope shipping charge in USD. Omit to preserve its current amount.

packageFlatRateUsd.description: Seller-selected flat package shipping charge in USD. Required.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_shipping_policy_set
